scope: Fresh source/Danish spot check of one recorded edited passage per gate-passing book. Not a full new linguistic review or native sign-off.

results.finding: Kinship, Oedipus curse, catalogue of suffering and proclamation treating loved ones as enemies retained.
Character description, narrator qualification and satirical71nobleancestors retained.
Safe arrival, sister’s forebodings and growing confidence retained.
Uncertain paternity, withheld knowledge, infant separation and author’s stated conjecture retained; no sanitizing.
Self-knowledge paradox, quoted treasure/heart and hive/honey imagery retained.
Yawl, anchored rest, incoming tide and waiting for turn of tide retained; technical vessel word intentional.
Authorial fiction disclaimer, necessity argument and two-part structure retained and clearly attributed.
Alms, endurance through suffering/age/nobility and strangers’ obligation to ask locals retained.
Suppliants’ wool-bound olive branches, incense, king’s personal arrival and spokesman retained.
Conditional heirs’ rights, succession and absence of natural/divine positive rule retained.
